Both ResStock and NEMS’s residential module make use of RECS as a major data source. To understand how well these two models align in load estimates for AEO’s 2018 base year, Figure 4 and Figure 5 compare their modeled dwelling unit count and floor area, electric load and natural gas consumption, respectively, differentiated by building type (denoted by marker color) and census division (denoted by marker shape). The plots show general agreement between ResStock and AEO in both the size of the housing stock and energy consumption. Both the modeled dwelling unit count and total floor area are aligned with AEO’s within ±20% of discrepancy. Most of the modeled electricity uses are within ±25% of AEO’s. The modeled natural gas uses for single-family homes are lower by 10-75% compared to AEO but comparable for other housing types.
